hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a staking and reward distribution system for SuperDCA token pools. Users stake SuperDCATokens to direct rewards to specific pools; on each liquidity event, accrued rewards are minted and split equally between the pool and developer. Applies dynamic fees (0% for allowlisted internal addresses, 1% for all others) on each swap.
